body:
### What are you really trying to do?

Spawn a child workflow from a long running workflow.

### Describe the bug

After upgrading from typescript sdk 1.11 to 1.15 child workflows started failing with "Root workflow execution is missing a field that should be defined".
We have traced this down to a change in the typescript sdk https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/pull/1662 (released in 1.12).

The error stems from the child being started with a `rootWorkflowExecution": {}` (empty object) when the workflow was originally created on Temporal Server 1.23.


### Minimal Reproduction

1. Create a workflow on server 1.23
2. Upgrade to server 1.24+ and typescript 1.15
3. Trigger child workflow

The following has a sample that reproduces this (in two branches - same code, different server and typescript versions)

Start old server version and start workflow:
https://github.com/andrewspinks/temporal-playground/tree/child-workflow-bug-old-version/ts/child-continue-as-new

Re-start server / worker with new versions and trigger child workflow:
https://github.com/andrewspinks/temporal-playground/tree/child-workflow-bug-updated/ts/child-continue-as-new

### Environment/Versions

- OS and processor: M4 Mac
- Temporal Version: typescript 1.15
- Docker

### Additional context

This is what the first event looks like for the child workflow when the parent was created pre server 1.24
(notice the `rootWorkflowExecution` field)
